thread:
Maya Chen: Pushing a quick Figma link with the trace-viewer iteration — focusing on error drilldowns + export actions. looking for quick UX + accessibility nits. https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/trace-viewer-v3
Jordan Patel: Nice! first glance: love the compact timeline. can we collapse repeated spans by default? customers hate scrolling for the same db call repeated.
Liam O'Neal: Agreed with collapse. also need clear indication when trace is partial (eg missing spans due to sampling). maybe a subtle banner: "Partial trace — some spans omitted" with an info icon.
Maya Chen: Good call. i'll add a banner. UX q: export flow — current mock shows "Export" dropdown with CSV/JSON. copy should say: "Export raw trace (JSON)" vs "Export table (CSV)"?
Anya Rao: prefer explicit copy. users often expect CSV to be a flattened table. so label as you suggested. also add a small tooltip: "Includes correlation IDs and durations".
Samir Khan: Accessibility: contrast on the timeline heatmap (orange on light grey) fails AA. need higher contrast or pattern fill for colorblind. Also keyboard: can you tab to spans and press Enter to open detail? focus ring visible?
Maya Chen: noted — will update colors and add focus states. thoughts on copy for trace links: currently shows "Open in Trace Viewer" vs "View Trace". which is clearer?
Jordan Patel: "Open in Trace Viewer" is explicit but long. maybe "Open trace" as compromise. and include a secondary small link: "Deep link (new tab)" for users who want direct URL.
Liam O'Neal: we should expose correlation IDs prominently — customers use them to cross-reference logs. suggestion: show correlation ID as a pill with a copy button and small chevrons to expand to related requests. e.g., "corr: 8a7f... \u2398 copy"
Maya Chen: That pill idea is good. i'll mock copy icon and tooltip "Copied!" microcopy.
Anya Rao: On the drilldown panel: include a tiny header row for request metadata (method, path, status, startedAt, duration). Makes quick troubleshooting faster without opening full span.
Samir Khan: For screen readers, ensure that each span detail uses role=region and aria-labelledby linking to span id/title. Also link text for the stack trace expansion should say "Expand stack frames for span X (opens in panel)" — avoids ambiguity.
Jordan Patel: Implementation note: when exporting JSON, include a top-level correlation_id and a link field with a stable deep link to the trace viewer with a query param ?trace_id=... That makes downstream import trivial.
Liam O'Neal: Also include small server-side: limit export size and present a warning if >5MB or >1000 spans, with suggestion to use partial export.
Maya Chen: UX for that: show a modal with two choices: "Export visible spans (current view)" and "Export full trace (might be large)" + size estimate.
ops-bot: Incident detector: error spike for service-payment at 11:28 UTC — 120% above baseline. Correlation id sample: 8a7f3c2d.
Jordan Patel: ops-bot message is useful to show in UI as a pin? maybe allow dragging a sample event into the trace viewer to open a corresponding trace. quick win for oncall.
Anya Rao: small copy nit: replace "correlation id" with "correlation ID" across UI to be consistent. also lowercase vs Title Case in the export modal — pick one.
Samir Khan: keyboard shortcut suggestion: when trace viewer focused, press "c" to copy correlation id, "e" to open export modal. ensure shortcuts are discoverable via a "?" help overlay.
Maya Chen: love the shortcuts idea. will add to prototype. final ask for devs: can we make the deep link stable across versions? Jordan?
Jordan Patel: yes — backend will return stable URLs. we'll add a short-lived signed token for private traces. for public/internal allowed traces just trace_id param.
Maya Chen: thanks everyone — i'll iterate and share updated frames tomorrow. leaving checklist: collapse repeats, partial-trace banner, export labels + size warning modal, correlation ID pill + copy, higher contrast/pattern for timeline, keyboard focus states, aria regions, shortcut hints.
Liam O'Neal: +1 on checklist. small question: add an option to export stack frames as a separate file? some customers want raw frames for Sentry-like ingestion.
Maya Chen: i'll add "Export stack frames (NDJSON)" to the dropdown.
Anya Rao: and add small UX hint: "Exported files include metadata: service, env, trace_id, correlation_id" so support teams know what to expect.
Samir Khan: once done, i'll run an a11y scan and flag any remaining color/label issues.
Maya Chen: perfect — thanks all. will post updated Figma link when ready.
